sentences.text: Task 4, Cherry and her friend Roland are listening to a podcast about online systems.
Complete the information in the spaces provided as you listen.
Please note that for the summary of the podcast you should use no more than three words to complete each gap.
You now have one minute to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have two minutes to tidy up your answers.
you want to listen to that podcast I was telling you about?
It’s by a guy called Jerry Brooker and he talks he’s talking about how, what the effect is of social networks on people’s use of email.
Cool, let’s listen.
OK, here we go.
The idea of email becoming extinct anytime soon may seem silly.
But chances are strong that you used web -based email less in 2011 than in 2010.
A recent report, The 2012 U .S.
Digital Year in Review, showed that web -based email usage was down for just about every age group under 55 from 2010 to 2011, with the 12 to 17 age group showing the largest
just decline at a staggering 59 Web -based email or webmail refers to email access through a browser.
so think Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo!
mail, et cetera, as the majority of email usage analyzed in this report.
This means that the groups of people who make up the majority of internet users and have the most experienced with email are now actually moving away from the medium.
The report also noted that email usage among seniors has increased, which isn’t surprising as a larger percentage of older people today have had more exposure to the web than their predecessors.
The report also went into detail on what sites people spent their time on.
It showed time spent on webmail sites declined while social networking sites has shown a drastic increase.
People are spending more time on social networking sites and less time on email sites and this is good news for social network sites.
Last fall Facebook founder, Mark Zuckerberg predicted the death of email when he introduced Facebook's new messaging interface, face.
We don’t think that a modern messaging system is going to be email, Zuckerberg said at a press conference in San Francisco.
Facebook users are now able to communicate through Facebook via text, email or instant message and receive communications from all of these avenues through one news feed.
Users typically value when related information from a variety of channels is consolidated into one place and that’s what Facebook’s messaging interface is trying to accomplish for users.
Many organisations with well -established IT departments have typically hosted email in -house, whereas others as of lately have turned to cloud email services services like Gmail.
This switch is attractive as it simply cuts costs.
While many companies and large universities are making the switch to cloud -based email services, will they make another shift towards using social networks to communicate?

One social networking system that businesses are turning to is called Collabro Chatter, a business collaboration tool which which describes itself as an effective means of connecting with prospective customers.

Collabro Chatter claims that by providing a system that puts businesses in easy contact with potential customers Collabro Chatter offers a genuine opportunity for companies to advance office productivity and
efficiency. efficiency. And increased productivity and efficiency is music to any boss’s ears in these or any times Well that’s it.
What do you think, Roland?
Hmm, He makes some good points, but I don't think e -mails going to disappear.
I mean, people could maybe use less e -mail, but they'll still use it to receive more, like Personal no messages.
You know, private stuff.
That's always going to be a big concern for people.
You know, privacy.
So I don’t know, I can’t see it myself.
I actually found what he said really really interesting.
I mean, doing business using social networking Sounds like great fun, I might even go into business myself.
